instruction: Navigate to the safety information page on the Virginia DMV website.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated Virginia DMV website from homepage through LICENSES & IDS menu to Driver's License section and found the eligibility requirements page in 10 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate hierarchical menus on government websites, click through multi-level navigation, identify and click relevant links, scroll to read page content
metadata.task_rationale: Tests navigation to a different top-level section (SAFETY) instead of LICENSES & IDS. The SAFETY link is visible in the main navigation bar. This variation requires the model to explore a different branch of the site's navigation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the safety section of Virginia DMV. The evaluator checks that the active URL contains 'safety' under the dmv.virginia.gov domain. The SAFETY link is visible in the top navigation bar.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (with 'expected' key containing regex patterns) and matches them against the result URL using re.search.
Regex pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov.*safety' correctly verifies the URL is on the Virginia DMV domain and contains 'safety' in the path, matching the instruction requirement.
The goto_prefix 'https://www.' is appropriate since the accessibility tree URL text typically omits the protocol prefix.
Single-step instruction (navigate to safety page) is fully covered by the single URL check — no missing verification steps.
Config correctly opens the Virginia DMV homepage as the starting point for the navigation task.
